description: PSDA Piano Stralcio di Difesa dalle Alluvioni is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by autoritabacini.regione.abruzzo.it. The PSDA identifies and surrounds areas of hydraulic hazard by determining the levels corresponding to full maximum conditions evaluated by scientific methods of hydraulics. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PSDA Flood Defense Plan" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include pericolosità idraulica. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
